body:
T+0 (5:45pm) Dropped 100mg.
T+0:45 Feel slightly droopy, could just be actual tiredness though, not intoxicated.
T+1:55 Definite effects, fairly mild. still completely clear headed but changes notable in sensation.
T+3:20 Watching waking life, pretty weird because I feel like I'm dreaming too. The movie was a series of philosophical conversations in a dream. I was able to follow the logic of these somewhat complicated conversations fine. Definitely a lot more clearheaded than MXE. Strong body high with significant relaxation and a feeling of calmness. Classic dissociative feelings, less physically euphoric than MXE though.
T+4:00 Snorted ~7mg of 2C-B, gave me some more energy but also added a lot of confusion to the trip. Tried going out with some friend but was fairly confused about what was going on and didn't have a ton of energy. The place we went ended up being at capacity and it was freezing outside (though it didn't bother me at all) so everyone ran back and I followed.
T+5:30 Definitely less dissociated, think most of my high is from the bump of 2C-B now.
T+6:45 I think the ephenidine is completely gone now. I am just in the stimulation that is the end of a 2C-B trip. Watched a couple episodes of the X Files with my SO.
T+8:45 Took a ton of melatonin and fell asleep pretty quickly, slept a good 10 hours.
Thoughts: Overall seems like a pretty good drug, don't think I'll order it again as dissociatives aren't my fave, but was worth a try. I have a bit left and will probably mix it with a good trip, maybe 20mg of 2C-B or 4-AcO-DMT. Didn't feel super stimulating as some have said but definitely less of a completely fucked in the mind feeling than MXE.
